description: Reviewed NM0 deployment-only changes: twenty combined opening bodies, exact half aerial opening quotas rounded down, and ten-to-five-percent aerial reinforcement probability. Earlier source locks remain intact; positions, combat, reserve debit and arrival timing are unchanged.

triggerGateAmbush.reason: Replace the three fifteen-body flank loops with seven/seven/six bodies, including one rather than three aerials; retain the full 150-person counter and existing approaches.

spawnAmbushReinforcement.reason: Halve aerial probability to five percent while retaining ten percent heavy and every reserve, pursuit, spawn-position and Grey encounter branch.

triggerOutpostAmbush.reason: Allocate the twenty-body fort opening as seventeen standard, two heavy and one aerial; blocked stations still return their bodies to reserve.

spawnFortWave.reason: Halve only the aerial probability to five percent while preserving ten percent heavy, reserve debit, identity and arrival placement.

spawnNm0OpeningFlank.reason: Extract the existing standard/heavy/aerial construction loops with their original spatial jitter and hostile factory.
